title: Emails
subtitle: Every message the system has ingested.
emptyTitle: No emails have been processed yet.
emptyDescription: Emails will appear here once ingestion begins.
bodyHidden: Body hidden by default — untrusted content.
notAnalyzedDescription: Jev's analysis will appear here once this email has been processed.
noDecisionDescription: This email hasn't been routed by the rule engine yet.
auditEmpty: No audit events recorded for this email yet.
bodyPurged: The content of this email was removed on {date} by the organization's retention policy. The subject, Jev's analysis and the routing decision are kept.
bodyNotLoaded: Body not loaded — request it explicitly to view.
bodyNoPlainText: This message has no plain-text body. HTML content exists but is not rendered (untrusted content — see security notes).
bodyTruncated: This body was truncated for display. The full message is preserved in storage.
decisionUnmatchedNote: No rule matched this email → routed to Human Review.
decisionForcedNote: Jev's own human_review_required signal overrode normal routing → routed to Human Review.
decisionAllowedNote: The sender is on the allow list ({pattern}) → left alone: no rule, no action, no review.
decisionBlockedNote: The sender is on the block list ({pattern}) → sent to the block destination before any rule ran.
decisionMissingAnalysisNote: No successful analysis existed yet when this decision was made.
previewChanged: With today's rules this email would go to {after} instead of {before}.
previewSame: Today's rules would decide the same: {after}.
reprocessFailed: The email could not be reprocessed.
reprocessConfirmDescription: It goes through today's rules, lists and graphs again, and the new decision's actions run (moves, forwards, webhooks). The current decision is kept in the history. Jev is not asked again.
skipHeadersUnknown: it arrived before auto-replies could check its headers
skipMailingList: it came from a mailing list
skipNoReplyAddress: the sender is a no-reply address
skipOwnMail: it came from Eumaeus or one of your own mailboxes
alreadyGone: Already gone from the inbox when this ran; nothing to move.
noFlagsSet: The message had already left its folder, so no flags were set.
ambiguousNote: The remote operation may have already succeeded — its outcome could not be confirmed, so it is not retried automatically.
undoFailed: The move could not be undone.
retryConfirmDescription: This resumes the existing queued job for this destination — it will not create a duplicate execution.
undoConfirmDescription: The message goes back from "{from}" to {to} in the mailbox. Eumaeus will recognize it there and won't route it again.
reanalyzeHelp: Runs a new Jev analysis first — this uses a Jev call and picks up your organization's new questions. Without it, the stored analysis is reused.
reprocessConfirmReanalyze: Jev will analyze the email again first (uses a Jev call).
correctFailed: The email could not be moved.
correctConfirmDescription: If Eumaeus moved this email, it is moved back first, then it goes to {destination} and that destination's actions run. This is recorded as your decision.
correctDone: Done — the email now goes to {destination}.
correctRuleFailed: The rule suggestion could not be loaded.
correctRuleHelp: A rule that would have sent this email where it belongs. Nothing is saved until you create it.
correctAlsoWrong_one: {count} other recent email from this sender went to {wrong} too.
correctAlsoWrong_other: {count} other recent emails from this sender went to {wrong} too.
correctRuleCreateFailed: The rule could not be created.
correctConfirmDescriptionInbox: If Eumaeus moved this email, it is moved back to the inbox and left there. This is recorded as your decision.
correctDoneInbox: Done — the email is back in the inbox and left alone.
correctAlsoWrong: {count} other recent emails from this sender went to {wrong} too.
authNoVerdict: The mail provider added no SPF/DKIM/DMARC result to this message.
deleteConfirmDescription: Eumaeus's copy is deleted with its analysis, decisions, actions and review items. This can't be undone. The messages in the mailbox are not touched. The audit trail keeps that they existed, without their content.
